question: Who transmitted the teaching to the earth-moving beings described as good eaters?
premises: They are described as good eaters
inference: An earth-moving being transmitted the teaching to the earth-moving beings, the good eaters.
uncertainties: The distinction between singular bhūcarī as agent and plural bhūcarīṇāṃ as recipients is preserved as given.
plain_english: O beloved, it was told to the earth-moving beings, the good eaters, by an earth-mover.
